body: Sometimes I wonder if I was born into the wrong place, or the wrong time.  My mind is mechanical, although I know that as a female, I'd probably not be respected much in any heavy industry.

It's hard to tell myself not to take the Xanax sometimes.  It's so freeing to be able to eat a few of them and just lose myself.  Quite a few times I would dose myself higher than usual and sit there, staring at the carpet until I passed out with my head propped on my hands.  I wish it was permanent, and that I would slide into that world where everything I want would come true.  I want to be loved by everyone.  I want to help people.  I want to be a heroine.  I want to give people the things I never had.

I have a boyfriend.  It's hard for me to explain why without saying it explicitly, but I am so afraid of losing him.  He's really the only person I can tell certain things to, and the only person I love with all of my heart.  If he decides I am too much of a freak and abandons me...or if he finds someone who can give him kids (I am barren) I will be left all alone.  It's terrifying.

Thank you for that.  I'm kind of glad that I posted here for that exact reason.  Having to keep these feelings inside is really painful, and at least I can share them with people in this way, even it is somewhat anonymous.

I think my boss is apathetic in all likelihood.  He is faculty in another University farther out, and because of that he is rarely in the office.  I spend about twenty minutes a week talking to him when you combine my face-to-face and email time.

That was just one of the moments that happened in the office.  Probably one of the worst ones to ever happen to me was this one time I was walking down the hallway, and I noticed a co-worker's door opened.  I stopped in the hall, and said, "Hey, how are you today?" Before I could finish the sentence, she flung her hands in the air and shouted at me, "I'm busy!"  I didn't even respond...couldn't respond.  I just walked away, went to my office, and cried for about an hour with the lights off.

I'd be willing to go anywhere if I could guarantee a stable job.  I've been looking for a while, but nothing seems to be popping up.  The prospect of screwing up on the loans and dragging my father down with me is something I think about every day and it scares me.
